name: gr-dvbs2rx
description: GNU Radio out-of-tree module with full DVB-S2 transmitter and receiver implementations for SDR. Supports RTL-SDR, USRP, PlutoSDR, and BladeRF for satellite signal reception and processing.

docker_support.docker_evidence: Dockerfile and .dockerignore present in repository root for containerized build and deployment.

eval_notes: Complete DVB-S2 transceiver for satellite signal processing. Agents could configure receiver parameters, optimize MODCOD selection, troubleshoot signal lock issues, and benchmark FEC performance.
